Anifrolumab (Saphnelo), a monoclonal antibody (mAb) that inhibits subunit 1 of the type I interferon receptor (IFNAR1), is a new biological product. The proposed indication is treatment of adults with moderate to severe systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) (b) (4). The proposed dosing regimen is 300 mg every 4 weeks administered as an intravenous (IV) infusion.

key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (≥5%): upper respiratory tract infection (34% vs 23% placebo), bronchitis (11% vs 5.2%), infusion-related reactions (9.4% vs 7.1%), herpes zoster (6.1% vs 1.3%), and cough (5.0% vs 3.2%). Serious and sometimes fatal infections have occurred; increased risk of respiratory infections and herpes zoster.
